reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, linking microstructural evolution (coarsening of intermetallics) to electrochemical and oxidation behavior via micro-galvanic coupling and passivation disruption, though it assumes Ti/Zn-rich phases without specifying the full alloy composition.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with specific techniques (TEM/SEM, potentiodynamic polarization, TGA) and a decisive falsification criterion, though the exact alloy composition and processing details are not fully specified.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the underexplored evolution-corrosion-oxidation link in Mg-containing lightweight HEAs, providing a testable mechanism that would advance understanding beyond prior hardness/compression-focused work.
